statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' | sed "s|^$HOME|~|"); style=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.output_style.name // empty'); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // 0'); branch=$(git -C "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // "."')" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); parts=''; if [ -n "$cwd" ] && [ -n "$branch" ]; then parts="$cwd [$branch]"; elif [ -n "$cwd" ]; then parts="$cwd"; fi; if [ -n "$style" ]; then parts="$parts | $style"; fi; if [ -n "$ctx" ]; then parts="$parts | ${ctx}% ctx left"; fi; cost_fmt=$(printf "$%.2f" "$cost"); parts="$parts | $cost_fmt"; echo "$parts"
